problem_statement: The string utility API must provide `memxor()` and `memcpy_reversed()`. `memxor()` must XOR the corresponding bytes of a source buffer into a destination buffer for the requested number of bytes, leaving each destination byte as its original value XOR the corresponding source byte. It must also work when the destination and source regions overlap. `memcpy_reversed()` must copy the requested number of bytes from a source buffer to a destination buffer in reverse byte order, so the first byte of the destination receives the last byte of the source and the last byte of the destination receives the first byte of the source.
